title: Design System: Traffic Intersection Flow Simulator

heading.purpose: Sub-group headings (h3/h4): arms, phases, overlay groups.

label.purpose: Legends, field labels, table heads, hints — the panel workhorse.

value-mono.purpose: Every number, stat, readout, and all canvas text.

components.name: Instrument Button
components.description: Neutral action button — optimizer run/cancel/apply, pause.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: inherit; color: var(--text, #d7dde8); background: #1a212d; border: 1px solid var(--panel-border, #232a36); border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #384359; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6fb7ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Pressed Toggle Button
components.description: Toggle in its active state (aria-pressed) — accent border + accent text.
components.css: .ds-btn-pressed { font: inherit; color: var(--accent, #6fb7ff); background: #1a212d; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #6fb7ff); border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-pressed:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6fb7ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Slider Field
components.description: Range control with inline live value — the primary tuning instrument.
components.css: .ds-slider { margin: 6px 0; } .ds-slider label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim, #8b95a6); } .ds-slider output { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--accent, #6fb7ff); } .ds-slider input[type='range'] { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--accent, #6fb7ff); margin: 4px 0 0; } .ds-slider input[type='range']:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6fb7ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Fieldset Group
components.description: The panel's grouping unit — hairline box, dim legend.
components.css: .ds-fieldset { border: 1px solid var(--panel-border, #232a36); border-radius: 6px; margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 8px 10px 10px; } .ds-fieldset legend { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim, #8b95a6); padding: 0 4px; } .ds-fieldset-body { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text, #d7dde8); }

components.name: Stat Readout
components.description: Headline metric — dim label inline-before accent mono value.
components.css: .ds-stat { white-space: nowrap; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim, #8b95a6); margin-right: 6px; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: var(--accent, #6fb7ff); }

components.name: Arm Bar
components.description: Per-arm delay bar (engineering overlay) — length is the encoding, color never varies.
components.html: North9.1 s
components.css: .ds-armbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52px 1fr 72px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-armbar-name { color: var(--text-dim, #8b95a6); } .ds-armbar-track { height: 10px; background: #1a212d; border: 1px solid var(--panel-border, #232a36); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-armbar-fill { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent, #6fb7ff); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-armbar-value { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-align: right; color: var(--text, #d7dde8); }

components.name: Optimizer Row (best)
components.description: Ranked sweep result — best candidate tinted, accent badge; current plan uses a dashed accent outline instead.
components.html: 15+26+5+7BEST−81%
components.css: .ds-optrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--panel-border, #232a36); color: var(--text, #d7dde8); } .ds-optrow-best { background: #16233a; } .ds-optrow-rank { color: var(--text-dim, #8b95a6); } .ds-optrow-greens, .ds-optrow-delta { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid var(--panel-border, #232a36); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--text-dim, #8b95a6); } .ds-badge-best { border-color: var(--accent, #6fb7ff); color: var(--accent, #6fb7ff); }

components.name: Lane Row (selected)
components.description: Selected lane editor row — Selected Row tint + accent outline.
components.css: .ds-lanerow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 4px 0; padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: #16202e; outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #6fb7ff); } .ds-lanerow-name { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim, #8b95a6); }

narrative.overview: The interface is a dark, instrument-lit control room for a single intersection. The chrome recedes into near-black slate so the simulation stays the brightest object on stage. One cool blue accent is the only voice the interface itself speaks: focus rings, selected values, the data line, selection highlights. Everything vivid beyond that belongs to the simulated world, not to the UI. The result reads as instrumented calm: quiet, precise, data-forward, nothing shouting. Discipline is the aesthetic: contrast ratios are pinned by tests, depth is tonal, state is expressed by line and color, never by motion or gloss.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal ladder of near-black slate surfaces, separated by 1px hairlines
Exactly one UI accent (Instrument Blue) shared by interaction, selection, and data
Green/yellow/red reserved exclusively for signal semantics; amber means queue/attention
Monospace for every number; system sans for every word
Flat: zero shadows, zero gradients, zero transitions — state changes are instant
Contrast ratios test-pinned (palette.test.ts), with three documented sub-bar floors

rules.name: The Reserved Signal Rule
rules.body: Green, yellow, and red appear only as signal semantics (lamps, stop signs, FPS health). The UI never uses them decoratively; success in chrome is Instrument Blue, not green.

rules.name: The One Instrument Rule
rules.body: One accent for interaction, selection, and data. If a screen needs a second UI color, the design is wrong — amber and violet exist only inside the simulation.

rules.name: The Earned Contrast Rule
rules.body: Sub-3:1 contrast is allowed only for the three documented floors (asphalt-vs-backdrop, signal-housing fill, chart gridlines). Every other text/graphic pair meets WCAG. New work must extend palette.test.ts, not argue exceptions.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Any glyph that is a measurement renders in the mono stack. Sans is for language; mono is for data. The two stacks are the entire type system.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No shadows, ever — in DOM or canvas. If a new element feels like it needs one, it needs a lighter fill or an accent border instead.

dos: Do add every new color to src/ui/styles/palette.ts with its measured contrast ratio in the doc comment — the test-pinned audit is the system's source of authority.
Do express state with tonal steps, accent borders, or dashed-vs-solid lines.
Do keep every number in the mono stack at 12–14px with its label in 12px Text Dim.
Do reserve saturated color for the simulated world; chrome speaks slate + Instrument Blue.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glow, or transitions — the instant, flat, tonal response is the aesthetic.
Don't use green/yellow/red in the UI chrome; they mean signal state only.
Don't introduce a second UI accent.
Don't widen the type system — two stacks, five sizes, complete.
Don't compose below 1280×720 intent (pinned product constraint).
